protocol.timing_scope: synchronous full decode, dispatch/waits/result stores and reset; final drain inside last batch block; latency final drain separately included in complete total; one resident OpenMP team; setup/warmup/checking/CSV excluded
protocol.remaining_scope: normalized unmatched seeds in both X/Z components after actual pipeline joined prefix, before MWPM; separate instrumented full replay; summed and averaged per independent shot
protocol.ordering: same unit pairs all methods on one host; cyclic first method by distance and repeat; one job per node
protocol.correctness: all shot IDs/events/weights checked; equal optimum observable ties require actual candidate parity/weight/observable witness; all differences retained
protocol.latency_summary: nearest-rank p50/p90/p99/p99.9/max, raw per-shot CSV retained; one latency pass, no Min3 claim
protocol.stopping: all seven settings; all three policies; no performance-dependent stopping or outlier removal
